description: NaBa(B₃O₅)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.28 Å) and three longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.84-2.97 Å. There are three inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.47 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.35-1.39 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.36 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond length. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ba and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ba and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ba and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two B atoms.
